title: A staged project
bodyMd: A firm can build a full warehouse immediately or lease a smaller facility while testing demand. The smaller lease costs more per unit of space, but can be ended after one year. The finance team says the higher unit price buys flexibility if demand disappoints. It recommends comparing whole scenarios, including exit costs and expansion needs, rather than choosing solely by rent per square metre.
